blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas men started their Asian Games 2026 campaign off the wrong foot after getting swept by South Korea, 16-25, 25-27, 22-25, on Sunday at Park Arena Komaki in Aichi, Japan. Bryan Bagunas and Joshua Magalaman powered Alas to a gallant stand in the second set, with the captain sending them to set point advantage twice — the last at 25-24 — only for him to miss his serve and commit an attack fault.
